title: An account whose H2 row was written the way the admin console and SCIM always write it (the same role listed twice) is still found and enforced: a demoted admin is refused, not left to the authenticator

criteria.given: the admin's H2 role list was rewritten to a shape the stores produce on every console/SCIM create — ROLE_USER listed twice, ROLE_ADMIN gone (JdbcUserDAO.insert always prepends ROLE_USER, so a caller that sends it duplicates it)
criteria.then: the row is still treated as FOUND and managed: the next /rest/saiku/admin/** request is refused with 403 because the stored row no longer lists an admin role, instead of being read as unparseable/unmanaged and the authenticator's admin authority left in place (saiku#2431: Set.of threw on the duplicate and the catch turned a found row into UNMANAGED)

criteria.given: a role list that contains the same role twice is written through PUT /rest/saiku/admin/users/{username} — the exact duplicate shape the console and SCIM create paths produce via JdbcUserDAO.insert
criteria.then: the write is accepted with 200, so the repro's precondition is reachable through the REST surface the admin console itself uses

steps.name: the admin session still has admin authority before the rewrite

expect.because: the seeded admin row parses cleanly, so the baseline must be an admin answering 200

steps.name: the console/SCIM-shaped duplicate role write is accepted

expect.because: the duplicate ROLE_USER list is the normal shape of a console/SCIM-created row and must not fail the write

steps.name: cooldown: outlive the ~2s status cache so the next admin read is fresh

expect.because: an anonymous endpoint, polled to burn wall time past the policy's 2s lookup cache without touching it

steps.name: cooldown (second pass): the fresh read must happen after the cached entry expired
the demoted admin is refused: the row was found and enforced, not discarded as unparseable

expect.because: the H2 row for admin exists, is enabled, and lists no admin role — the URL gate hasRole('ADMIN') must refuse the request; on saiku#2431's base the duplicate role made the row read as UNMANAGED and this stayed 200
